rcuk_abcde.title: Resuscitation Council UK: The ABCDE Approach

body.coordinateSystem: normalized image coordinates; optional in addition to region ID
body.laterality: patient anatomical right and left; independent of display orientation

label.da: For flere dage siden (under en uge)
label.en: Several days ago (less than a week)

da.text: Jeg er her for at hjælpe dig.

en.text: I am here to help you.

da.text: Jeg arbejder i ambulancen.

en.text: I work on the ambulance crew.

da.text: Jeg er læge.

en.text: I am a doctor.

da.text: Jeg er sygeplejerske.

en.text: I am a nurse.

da.text: Vi vil gerne stille dig nogle spørgsmål.

en.text: We would like to ask you some questions.

da.text: Du kan svare ved at trykke på skærmen.

en.text: You can answer by tapping the screen.

da.text: Forstår du sproget på skærmen?

en.text: Do you understand the language on the screen?

da.text: Kan du læse dette?

en.text: Can you read this?

da.text: Kan du se teksten tydeligt?

en.text: Can you see the text clearly?

da.text: Kan du høre mig?

en.text: Can you hear me?

da.text: Har du brug for en tolk?

en.text: Do you need an interpreter?

da.text: Vil du have en pause?

en.text: Would you like a break?

da.text: Vil du helst tale uden andre til stede?

en.text: Would you prefer to speak without other people present?

context.reviewNote: Use privately when safe; qualified interpreter and clinician-led follow-up required for risk assessment. A negative response does not establish safety.

da.text: Er der noget vigtigt, vi endnu ikke har spurgt om?

en.text: Is there something important we have not asked about yet?

da.text: Vis mig gerne, hvad du mener.

en.text: Please show me what you mean.

da.text: Vi vil forsøge at skaffe en tolk.

en.text: We will try to arrange an interpreter.

da.text: Vent et øjeblik, tak.

en.text: Please wait a moment.

da.text: Er det dig, der har brug for hjælp?

en.text: Are you the person who needs help?

da.text: Vil du gerne have en person, du kender, hos dig?

en.text: Would you like someone you know to stay with you?

da.text: Føler du dig syg?

en.text: Do you feel unwell?

da.text: Er du mere træt end normalt?

en.text: Are you more tired than usual?

da.text: Føler du dig svag i hele kroppen?

en.text: Do you feel weak throughout your body?

da.text: Har du haft feber?

en.text: Have you had a fever?

da.text: Har du målt din temperatur?

en.text: Have you measured your temperature?

da.text: Hvilken temperatur målte du i grader Celsius?

en.text: What temperature did you measure in degrees Celsius?

da.text: Har du haft kulderystelser?

en.text: Have you had chills?

da.text: Har du svedt usædvanligt meget?

en.text: Have you been sweating more than usual?

da.text: Har du haft nattesved?

en.text: Have you had night sweats?

da.text: Har du mistet appetitten?

en.text: Have you lost your appetite?

da.text: Har du tabt dig uden at ville det?

en.text: Have you lost weight without trying?

da.text: Har du taget hurtigt på i vægt for nylig?

en.text: Have you gained weight rapidly recently?

da.text: Føler du dig meget tørstig?

en.text: Do you feel very thirsty?

da.text: Har du været syg i dagene op til dette?

en.text: Have you been ill in the days leading up to this?

da.text: Er symptomerne nye for dig?

en.text: Are these symptoms new to you?

da.text: Har du haft lignende symptomer før?

en.text: Have you had similar symptoms before?

da.text: Er dine symptomer blevet værre?

en.text: Have your symptoms become worse?

da.text: Er dine symptomer blevet bedre?

en.text: Have your symptoms improved?

da.text: Er du blevet undersøgt for disse symptomer tidligere?

en.text: Have you previously been examined for these symptoms?

da.text: Har du smerter lige nu?

en.text: Are you in pain right now?

da.text: Peg på, hvor du har ondt.

en.text: Point to where you feel pain.

context.reviewNote: Use patient anatomical laterality. Distinguish location from radiation and sensory symptoms. Do not infer injury from selected region.

da.text: Peg på, hvor smerten breder sig hen.

en.text: Point to where the pain spreads.

context.reviewNote: Use patient anatomical laterality. Distinguish location from radiation and sensory symptoms. Do not infer injury from selected region.

da.text: Hvor stærk er smerten lige nu fra 0 til 10?

en.text: How severe is your pain right now, from 0 to 10?

da.text: Hvor stærk var smerten, da den var værst, fra 0 til 10?

en.text: How severe was your pain at its worst, from 0 to 10?

da.text: Begyndte smerten pludseligt?

en.text: Did the pain start suddenly?

da.text: Hvornår begyndte smerten?

en.text: When did the pain start?

context.timePrecision: Patient-reported broad onset category only; exact time is not inferred.

da.text: Var smerten stærkest, lige da den begyndte?

en.text: Was the pain at its worst when it started?

da.text: Er smerten konstant?

en.text: Is the pain constant?

en.text: Does the pain come in episodes?

en.text: How long does an episode usually last?

context.timePrecision: Preserve patient-reported precision, units and approximate flag; do not convert uncertain time to exact timestamp.

da.text: Bliver smerten værre, når du trækker vejret dybt?

en.text: Does taking a deep breath make the pain worse?

da.text: Bliver smerten værre, når du hoster?

en.text: Does coughing make the pain worse?

da.text: Bliver smerten værre ved fysisk anstrengelse?

en.text: Does physical exertion make the pain worse?

da.text: Bliver smerten mindre, når du hviler?

en.text: Does resting reduce the pain?

en.text: Does the pain change when you change position?

da.text: Har smertestillende medicin hjulpet?

en.text: Has pain-relieving medicine helped?

da.text: Føles smerten trykkende?

en.text: Does the pain feel like pressure?

da.text: Føles smerten stikkende?

en.text: Does the pain feel sharp or stabbing?

da.text: Føles smerten brændende?

en.text: Does the pain feel like burning?

en.text: Does the pain feel like throbbing?

da.text: Føles smerten krampende?

en.text: Does the pain feel like cramping?

da.text: Føles smerten som elektriske stød?

en.text: Does the pain feel like electric shocks?

da.text: Breder smerten sig til andre steder i kroppen?

en.text: Does the pain spread to other parts of your body?

da.text: Har du normalt smerter i dette område?

en.text: Do you usually have pain in this area?

da.text: Er denne smerte anderledes end dine sædvanlige smerter?

en.text: Is this pain different from your usual pain?

da.text: Har du svært ved at få luft på grund af noget i halsen?

en.text: Is something in your throat making it difficult to breathe?

en.text: Did something go down the wrong way?

da.text: Føles det, som om noget sidder fast i halsen?

en.text: Does it feel like something is stuck in your throat?

da.text: Har du svært ved at synke?

en.text: Do you have difficulty swallowing?

en.text: Do you have difficulty swallowing your own saliva?

da.text: Er din tunge hævet?

en.text: Is your tongue swollen?

da.text: Er dine læber hævede?

en.text: Are your lips swollen?

da.text: Føles din hals hævet indvendigt?

en.text: Does your throat feel swollen inside?

da.text: Er din stemme blevet hæs?

en.text: Has your voice become hoarse?

da.text: Gør det ondt, når du synker?

en.text: Does it hurt when you swallow?

da.text: Har du ondt i halsen?

en.text: Do you have a sore throat?

en.text: Did the problems begin after taking medicine?

en.text: Is this headache different from headaches you have had before?

en.text: Has your implanted defibrillator delivered a shock?

en.text: Have you previously had heart bypass surgery?

en.text: Do you become more short of breath with physical activity?

en.text: Does your breathing get worse when you lie flat?

en.text: Have you woken at night because you could not get enough air?

en.text: Have you coughed up blood?
